review_findings.finding: The frozen F_geo field has ample positive support, but the registered 5-pixel square local-maximum prefilter in the shared emitter leaves only 22 output cells before the 3-pixel Euclidean spacing pass. The support-capacity and all-fold budget-comparability gates therefore fail.
review_findings.interpretation: The negative recorded DTI differences are not valid matched-budget performance estimates. This run fails the registered emission/gate configuration; it does not establish that cold geothermometers have no geological value.
review_findings.action: No zero-score fill, threshold change, post-result rerun, or promotion. A future emitter correction would require a separately frozen protocol and complete new run.

review_findings.finding: The pseudo-AUC catalogue clearance used five iterations of scipy.ndimage.binary_dilation with its default cross connectivity. This does not exclude every pixel within a 500 m Euclidean radius (for example offset (3,3) is about 424 m but remains outside the cross-shaped mask).
review_findings.interpretation: The recorded pseudo-AUC values are exploratory and do not meet the exact preregistered negative-mask definition. They must not support a co-training conclusion. This issue does not alter the primary hide/block comparisons, which already fail budget comparability.
review_findings.action: Preserve raw values with this caveat; do not retrofit or rerun the opened H58 result. A future diagnostic requires a newly frozen Euclidean-clearance implementation.
